title: 법관윤리강령 / queue:ARTICLE:0:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Judges shall realize freedom, equality, and justice by guaranteeing the fundamental human rights of the people and the legitimate exercise of their rights, and shall establish the basic democratic order and the rule of law by exercising the judicial power entrusted to them by the people strictly in accordance with the law and their conscience.

To fulfill this mission, judges shall firmly safeguard judicial independence and the honor of the judiciary and earn the trust and respect of the people. Accordingly, judges shall perform their duties fairly and with integrity and maintain the high standards of professional ethics required of judges.

We, the judges, hereby unite to establish ethical standards and rules of conduct to be observed by judges, so as to renew our attitude and commitment as judges. Every judge shall observe this Code under his or her own responsibility and discipline and thereby fulfill the mission and responsibilities of a judge.
